notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.
